submitted.rationale: 45 (Bi0.10 Cu0.49 V0.41) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 11.5 µA. 4 (a Cu-alloyed BiVO4-like composition) gave 8.3 µA and 44 gave 3.2 µA. XRD shows 45, 44 and 103 share a common Cu-vanadate phase set. 44 has more of the Cu-rich phase (peaks near Q 0.97 and 1.75) and 103 has an extra phase (peaks near 1.48 and 1.58). The drop at 44 means the photocurrent peak sits at or on the V-rich side of 45.
